title: Aft Lower Shell Inner Doubler — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the inner doubler and the joint angle at a longitudinal skin joint of the aft lower shell, with the wet assembly, the fastening sequence and the drain path flow check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one inner doubler and its joint angle at a longitudinal skin joint of the aft lower shell, and the drain path check that closes the work.
sections.job_setup_note: The skin land must have been inspected and accepted by the removal task before this task starts. Sealant must be within its stated pot life and the ambient temperature at the work position must be between 15 and 30 degrees. The drain path flow check needs a measured water supply and the aircraft in the level attitude, so plan the task so that it finishes in one shift.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE AFT CARGO DOOR IS SAFE AGAINST INADVERTENT CLOSING AND THAT THE COMPARTMENT IS VENTILATED WHILE SEALANT IS APPLIED. 2. Ream the fastener holes to the applicable pattern with the drill jig, one hole at a time. 3. Do an eddy current inspection of every reamed hole and record the result. 4. CAUTION: DO NOT INSTALL A FASTENER IN A HOLE THAT HAS NOT BEEN INSPECTED. AN UNINSPECTED HOLE IS A REJECTABLE CONDITION. 5. Clean and dry the skin land and apply the primer. 6. Apply the faying surface sealant to the doubler D5331121169495 and to the joint angle D5331122892194. 7. Put the doubler and the angle in position and install the rivets EN545167-02, working from the centre of the joint towards each end. 8. Install the washers AGS334024-84 and the drain grommets at the six positions. 9. Apply the sealant fillet along the joint edge and smooth it. 10. Do the drain path flow check by pouring the measured quantity of water at the highest point of the joint land and confirming that it reaches the bilge outlet within the stated time. 11. Restore the protective treatment on all new surfaces.
sections.close_out: Let the sealant cure for the time given in the standard practice before the floor panels are installed. Install the cargo floor and lining panels. Do the cargo compartment lighting check. Record the installation, the eddy current results and the drain path check result in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The titanium doubler is installed on aircraft at or being brought to the corrosion-resistant doubler standard.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the aft cargo door is safe against inadvertent closing.
Ventilate the compartment while sealant is applied.
Use eye and skin protection when you handle sealant and primer.
